capabilities: Detect installed agent skills on startup
Mine usage from local session transcripts
Visualize usage, sessions, and revisions in a dashboard
Detect and preview unregistered skill revisions
Report data sources with ingest controls
disambiguation: Not about Obsidian's own capabilities; it tracks usage of AI agent skills recorded in Codex CLI and Claude Code sessions.
extras: Desktop only; requires Node.js filesystem access. No network calls and no vault writes; data stays in the plugin folder. .zst-compressed transcript archives are skipped. Not yet in the community store (install via BRAT or manual copy).
problem: Users cannot see which AI agent skills they actually use, how often, or how those skills change over time.

relations.evidence: local agent session transcripts (Codex CLI, Claude Code)
Only Codex CLI and Claude Code transcripts are mined today
sessions registered by the Claudian plugin for the current vault

summary: Desktop-only dashboard that mines local AI agent session transcripts to show skill usage, sessions, and revisions.
